title: Conormal sheaf of a closed immersion under (flat) base change
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$, $i':Z'\to X'$, $g:X\to X'$, $f:Z\to Z'$ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial] ($i,i'$ closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion], $g\circ i=i'\circ f$), with canonical map $c:f^*\mathcal C_{Z'/X'}\to\mathcal C_{Z/X}$ of conormal sheaves. Assume the square is cartesian, i.e. $(Z,i,f)$ is a fibre product of $g$ and $i'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $c$ is surjective; if moreover $g$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], then $c$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules. (Affine locally: for a ring map $R'\to R$ and an ideal $I'\subset R'$ with $I=I'R$, the map $I'/I'^2\otimes_{R'}R\to I/I^2$ is surjective, and bijective when $R'\to R$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 0473 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial-flat), case of closed immersions, with its proof; the ideal of the base-changed closed immersion is Schemes, Lemma 01JU (schemes-lemma-fibre-product-immersion) (1)

proof.text: The compatible affine charts U⊂g⁻¹(U') form a basis of X: at any x in any open W choose U' affine around g(x), then choose U affine inside W∩g⁻¹(U') around x. Pull this basis back along the closed embedding i to obtain a basis and affine cover of Z.

proof.text: On each basis open, use [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-affine-base-change-comparison] to conjugate c.app to Ideal.tensorCotangentHom A B J. The latter is surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-cotangent-flat-base-change-ring]. Transport through eS and eT to get a preimage of every section. For a section on any open W and a point z in W choose a basis neighbourhood V inside W, restrict the section to V, and use this sectionwise surjectivity to lift it. This proves local surjectivity, written as TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff from [lem-weil-pbc-locally-surjective-iff-stalks]. The underlying additive sheaf map is an epimorphism by Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective from the generic Mathlib match of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-epi-iff-stalks]. SheafOfModules.toSheaf is faithful and reflects epimorphisms, hence Epi c. Quasi-coherence and cokernels are not needed for this basis argument.

proof.text: If g is flat, [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-affine-criterion] makes each chart ring B flat over A. Ideal.tensorCotangentHom_injective_of_flat in [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-cotangent-flat-base-change-ring] gives injectivity. The comparison equivalences transfer this to injectivity of c.app on every basis open, hence bijectivity. Apply TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis from [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-morphism-on-basis] to the underlying additive sheaves. The toPresheaf functor reflects isomorphisms, so c itself is an isomorphism.

theorem closedImmersion_conormal_flat_base_change
    {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{uc}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (g : X ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (h : i ≫ g = f ≫ i')
    (hc : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk i f h))
    (c : (tensorPullback f).obj ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules) ⟶
      (tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
    (hcanonical : c = Classical.choose ((Classical.choose_spec
      (closedImmersion_conormal_functorial i i' g f h).2).2))
    : Epi c ∧ (Flat g → IsIso c)

reviewed_lean.note: schemes X Z X' Z', closed immersions i i', g f with i≫g=f≫i', cartesian as IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk i f h), c tied by hcanonical to the unique c of closedImmersion_conormal_functorial (conormal = tensorPullback i of i.ker.toModules as in that dep), conclusion Epi c ∧ (Flat g → IsIso c)
